gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-tangsa: Press Start 2P looks like cut-out letters pinned far apart. Noto Sans Tangsa is the sensible sans-serif counterpart, with wide, inviting round letters where the heading is all playful retro swagger.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-tc: Large open counters make Noto Sans TC read friendly and easygoing, with curves that flare outward. Press Start 2P has the retro fun, loud and gridlike, while Noto Sans TC does the quiet, steady work of carrying the words.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-telugu: Playful and retro, Press Start 2P spaces its blocky letters far apart with only a soft hint of thick and thin. And Noto Sans Telugu sits beneath it with a high midline and counters open to the outside, tidy and unshowy.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-thaana: Press Start 2P spaces its letters like cut-out shapes pinned far apart, with big open-looking bowls in the lowercase. Noto Sans Thaana's wide channels make it the friendlier partner.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-thai: Noto Sans Thai has a lowercase swollen like inflated glass beads. Its rounded letters stay open, so a long passage would feel soft and unhurried, while Press Start 2P keeps its felt-marker swelling to the headline.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-thai-loo: Press Start 2P pins its cut-out letters far apart. Noto Sans Thai Looped has tall lowercase bodies that look bold, with spacious gaps at the curve ends, so a long passage would feel clean and confident.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-tifinagh: Chunky, retro and pinned far apart, Press Start 2P brings the fun. And Noto Sans Tifinagh fills the line with rounded, inflated-looking bowls, so a larger size for the sans-serif lets those open shapes show.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-tirhuta: Press Start 2P brings retro fun, its letters pinned far apart like cut-outs with a gentle weight change where bowls curve. Noto Sans Tirhuta contributes a dominant x-height and cut-back terminals, and that contrast is the pair's real strength.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-ugaritic: Noto Sans Ugaritic sits with very little gap between x-height and cap height, its open mouths like a chalk arc left unjoined. Press Start 2P is best at loud, retro display moments, while Noto Sans Ugaritic is best at friendly, uncluttered text.
gen-press-start-2p-gf-noto-sans-vai: Press Start 2P is retro and playful, with joins that taper modestly. Noto Sans Vai does the opposite job, making words read as solid blocks with generous space between curve ends and the stem.
